does_not_do: It is not a data source itself; each provider keeps its own terms, and many need the user's own API key.
focus_reason: One interface over many of the official sources in this directory, with per-extension unit tests. 7 releases in the year; 51 open issues.
measured_against: Need: fetch market and economic data programmatically for research, from sources whose terms are clear.
tests_ci: Unit-test workflows for the core and for each data extension; linting and CodeQL.
what_it_is: The Open Data Platform: one toolset that connects proprietary, licensed and public data providers to Python, a REST API and an MCP server. Extensions include FRED, SEC, BLS, IMF, ECB and EIA. The former OpenBB-finance/OpenBB address redirects here.
